**Installation**: central model / firmware, indoor unit brand, number of zones, IAQ sensor (yes/no), radiant floor, other equipment.

**What works / what does not** (zones found, values right, values missing).

**Attach**:
- the diagnostics file (gateway page → Gateway → Download diagnostics; it contains no password);
- a listen-mode recording of a few minutes (TCP 7000 stream), ideally while you change one setting in the
  Airzone app (note the time and the setting).
